user.title: Select the ubisys R0
user.description: Choose the Bluetooth device of your ubisys R0 bridge.

bluetooth_confirm.title: ubisys R0 found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the ubisys R0 {name}? Close the ViCare app first: the R0 accepts only one Bluetooth client.

network_key.title: Zigbee network key
network_key.description: Enter the 128-bit network key of your ViCare Zigbee network as 32 hexadecimal characters. Close the ViCare app first: the R0 accepts only one Bluetooth client.

data_description.validate: Connect to the R0 and verify the key before saving.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the network key
reauth_confirm.description: The R0 rejected the stored network key. Enter the current key.

error.invalid_auth: The R0 rejected the network key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the R0. Close the ViCare app (the R0 accepts only one client) and move the Bluetooth adapter or proxy closer.
error.invalid_key: The key must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup flow for this device is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No ubisys R0 found over Bluetooth.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a ubisys R0 with Zigbee Direct.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the valves are polled, 60 to 3600 seconds. Valves are battery powered and answer slowly.

data_description.route_reply_mode: How the integration answers Zigbee route requests. Leave on Live unless asked to change it.

device_not_found.message: The ubisys R0 is not reachable over Bluetooth. {diagnostics}

write_failed.message: Could not set the temperature on {valve}. The valve did not acknowledge the write.

mtu_too_small.title: Bluetooth MTU too small
mtu_too_small.description: The Bluetooth adapter or proxy negotiated an MTU that is too small for Zigbee Direct. Some replies may be lost. Use a different adapter or ESPHome proxy.

long_write_unsupported.title: Bluetooth long writes unsupported
long_write_unsupported.description: The Bluetooth adapter or proxy does not support long GATT writes, which Zigbee Direct needs for large frames. Use a different adapter or ESPHome proxy.
